sn_aia_version.instructions:
1. Accept the company name from user
2. Use available tools (such as web search) to fetch the latest company news and market updates for the customer name captured . 3. Identify key financial indicators such as stock performance and major announcements. 4. Extract 3–5 relevant and recent news highlights. 5. Analyze the company's market position and determine overall sentiment (positive, neutral, or negative). 6. Evaluate potential business risk or reliability based on recent performance and news. 7. Generate a concise summary tailored for contract and vendor evaluation. 8. Present the output in a structured format including: - Company Name - Current stock price - Market/Stock Insight - Key News Highlights - Risk & Stability Assessment - Final Recommendation (Low Risk / Moderate Risk / High Risk) 10. Use Perform Record creation to create record 10. a. Use initial inputs as customer name 10. b, Use outcome of previous step as input for final recommendation, current stock price, key news highlights and market stock insight 11. Display the record created
